sentences.en: I love cooking various dishes, for example, pasta and pizza.
sentences.zh: 我喜欢烹饪各种菜肴，例如意大利面和披萨。

sentences.en: She enjoys reading different genres of books, for example, romance novels and mysteries.
sentences.zh: 她喜欢阅读不同类型的书籍，例如言情小说和悬疑小说。

sentences.en: We visited several places in New York City, for example, the Statue of Liberty and Central Park.
sentences.zh: 我们在纽约市参观了许多地方，例如自由女神像和中央公园。
